visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with manicured red nails holds a white and gold foot mask packet against a background of a beige travel bag and a blurred indoor setting. (2) Close-up of a bare heel on a white bedsheet; a finger points to dry, rough skin. (3) The camera angle shifts to the side of the foot, where a hand points to a darkened skin patch near the ankle bone. (4) The scene returns to a bathroom setting where the hand holds the mask pouch near various skincare bottles on a counter. (5) A white, bootie-shaped foot mask is pulled out and displayed over the person's lap. (6) The person is seen wearing both white plastic foot masks while sitting on a couch. (7) Hands reach down to adjust and secure the masks around the ankle area with a built-in adhesive strip. (8) The person wears white slippers over the masks and stands on a dark, floral-patterned carpet, demonstrating ease of movement. (9) A close-up reveals a hydrated, smooth heel being touched by a finger to show the change in texture. (10) Both feet are shown resting on a white cushion, looking moisturized with bright red toenail polish. (11) The video ends with a solid black screen displaying a website URL in white text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop music starts with a clear synthetic drum beat. A female narrator begins speaking in a friendly, high-energy tone. (2) As the narrator describes skin problems, the music continues steadily. There is a slight sound of plastic rustling as the product is handled. (3) The crinkling of plastic becomes more distinct as the foot mask is opened and applied. The narrator's voice remains clear and persuasive over the background track. (4) Soft muffled rhythmic sounds accompany the person walking on a soft surface. The narrator emphasizes the convenience of the product. (5) The narrator's voice rises in pitch and excitement while discussing the moisturizing results. The upbeat music remains consistent in volume until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Product Solution -> Application Process -> Result Demonstration -> Brand URL
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional product showcase for a foot mask by 'Wstyle'. It uses a standard before-and-after narrative to highlight common foot skin issues like dryness and dullness, then demonstrates the ease of using the mask (including the ability to walk in slippers while wearing it). The final segment shows successful moisturizing results to persuade viewers of the product's effectiveness.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product packaging and a final call-to-action with the brand's website URL.
